desc.short: 椭圆/圆角矩形/真圆三种形状的电影感暗角：smoothstep 羽化、乘性强度混合（HDR 安全），并可开启均值保持的亮度补偿防止整体画面变暗。

params.shape: 遮罩形状。椭圆：随画面比例的内切椭圆（默认）；矩形：与画面边框吻合的圆角矩形；圆形：宽高比纠正后的几何真圆（横幅下相对更收紧）。
params.feather: 羽化宽度。映射为暗角过渡带半宽；过渡 50% 点恒落在所选形状的名义边界上，任何羽化下形状读数不漂移。
params.strength: 暗角强度。乘性变暗（角点最深、中心为 0），对 HDR 高光与负值等比缩放，不裁切、不偏色。
params.luma_comp: 亮度补偿。0 为经典暗角；1 时按遮码帧平均施加反向增益，使整帧平均亮度基本保持不变（防整体变暗）。

desc.short: Cinematic vignette in three shapes (ellipse / rounded rectangle / true circle) with smoothstep feather, HDR-safe multiplicative strength and optional mean-preserving luma compensation.

params.shape: Mask shape. Ellipse: frame-proportioned inscribed oval (default). Rectangle: rounded box matching the frame edges. Circle: aspect-corrected geometric circle (relatively tighter on wide frames).
params.feather: Feather width, mapped to the transition half-width; the 50 percent point always sits on the selected shape's nominal boundary, so the shape reads true at any feather.
params.strength: Vignette strength. Multiplicative darkening (deepest at corners, zero at center) that scales HDR highlights and negative values proportionally, with no clamping or hue shift.
params.luma_comp: Luma compensation. 0 keeps the classic look; 1 applies a corrective gain based on the mask's frame average so overall brightness is largely preserved.
